hint.text: Fronted adverbials are words or phrases which give more information to sentences. They are called fronted adverbials because they appear at the front of the sentence. They are always followed by a comma.
hint.label: Fronted adverbial

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence.

atoms.b: ((Once a year)), we go to the beach.

instruction.text: Rebuild the sentence to include a fronted adverbial phrase.

atoms.a: She performed her ballet routine. It was graceful.
The castle stood on the cliff’s edge. It was far away.
We finished the journey at midnight. We were extremely tired.
We visit my grandpa to wish him happy birthday. We go once a year.
My sister helped me with my geography homework. She helped me in the morning.
